categories.name: Stereo Matching
categories.description: Techniques for extracting 3D structure from multi-view stereo pairs.

topics.name: Block Matching (SAD/NCC)
topics.description: Per-pixel horizontal search using Sum of Absolute Differences (SAD) or Normalized Cross-Correlation (NCC). Fast but sensitive to noise and repetitive textures.

topics.name: Plane-Sweep Stereo
topics.description: Hypothesizes ground-plane geometry to warp images and verify depth consistency. Ideal for flat surfaces like football fields.

topics.name: Semi-Global Matching (SGM)
topics.description: A dynamic programming approach that optimizes cost functions across multiple paths to enforce smoothness and handle occlusions.

topics.name: Neural Stereo (RAFT/CRE)
topics.description: Deep learning architectures that learn global context and semantic priors to resolve depth in low-texture or complex environments.

topics.name: Temporal Flow Hybrid
topics.description: Combines stereo disparity with optical flow to integrate information over time, increasing stability in dynamic video scenes.
